field_evidence.api_geometry_entity_semantics: Planning Data documentation states that geometry_entity filters entities using the geometry of the supplied entity ID and geometry_relation controls the spatial relation, including intersects.
field_evidence.target_outline: Forge Cottage listed-building-outline entity 42137146 is an authoritative Planning Data geometry linked to listed building 1071189, with MULTIPOLYGON geometry and POINT (0.910196 51.073494).
field_evidence.title_boundary_semantics: Planning Data describes title-boundary as HM Land Registry Index polygons showing the position and indicative extent of a registered property; published title-boundary entities expose authoritative MULTIPOLYGON geometry.
field_evidence.transport_result: The exact official geometry_entity/intersects query URL was attempted, but this transport reported that the URL is not accessible and returned no target-specific entity response.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: Without a retrieved target-specific title-boundary entity response, no title-boundary ID, geometry or bbox is promoted to canonical parcel state; spatial binding/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
